headline: Hormuz crisis set to reshape global energy markets, IEA warns
summary: The International Energy Agency warns that the Middle East conflict and Strait of Hormuz shipping disruptions will likely reshape global energy markets for years. Countries are reconsidering their dependence on imported fuels.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint for seaborne crude oil and LNG, so disruptions there feed directly into global energy prices and supply security.
